title: Astrid and the Archive
author: Marguerite Nystrom
blurb: Beatrix Zhou, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the jump window closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
